title: Home
body: nemo pcn stochastic demo genetic modelling and integrated management of the potato cyst nematode nemo pcn is a scientific python library for the simulation calibration and quantitative comparison of population management programmes targeting globodera pallida it follows individual offspring counts by genotype within annual programmes of susceptible or resistant potato cultivation nonhost rotations and suicide hatching biocontrol the modelling components are intended to work together without becoming inseparable demographic observations are fitted under a declared biological model stochastic and deterministic trajectories are evaluated under identical crop programmes and management outcomes are summarised at explicit planning horizons principal operations python import nemo_pcn as nemo result nemo run_simulation nemo parameters nemo schedule rnn years 30 virulence_frequency 0 2 initial_density 20 area_m2 0 05 n_replicates 1000 seed 42 print result outcomes 5 10 20 30 simulate stochastic population trajectories and a deterministic reference estimate demographic and genetic parameters from observation specific data compare susceptible cultivation masculinizing resistance host free rotation and suicide hatching efficacy explore drift selected virulence a separate neutral marker the reproductive bottleneck and demographic noise diagnostics export reproducible data tables scenario metadata and publication quality graphs scientific foundations the life cycle and genetic response are based on the model of tankam chedjou et al 2024 evolutionary applications the greenhouse aggregate example is based on contina dandurand and knudsen 2019 plant disease results are conditional predictions not field validated quarantine clearance probabilities documentation map start with installation installation html and quick start quick start html study the biological model model html for its equations then simulation simulation html management management html parameter estimation calibration html and genetic drift genetics html the api reference api html contains public signatures and links to detailed workflows

title: Installation
body: installation python requirements nemo pcn supports python 3 10 or newer and uses numpy scipy pandas and numba matplotlib and plotly are optional visual dependencies on a computer without network access the necessary wheels must be installed in advance install from a local folder after extracting the distribution archive open a terminal in its root bash python m venv venv windows venv scripts python m pip install upgrade pip venv scripts python m pip install e nemo pcn viz linux or macos venv bin python m pip install e nemo pcn viz an editable installation allows changes to the package source to take effect without a new wheel build after packaging on pypi install with bash python m pip install nemo pcn viz check the environment python import nemo_pcn as nemo print nemo __version__ assert nemo hardy_weinberg 0 2 sum 1 run the included suite bash python m pip install pytest python m pytest nemo pcn tests q numba compilation a numba kernel compiles on first execution the compilation takes longer than later calls and is not included in comparisons of steady state simulation speed thousands of trajectories can be simulated efficiently because replicates are parallelised runtime still increases with larger populations and longer calendars build a wheel bash python m pip install build twine python m build nemo pcn python m twine check nemo pcn dist always publish from a clean version controlled release and verify installation in a fresh virtual environment

title: Quick start
body: quick start step 1 describe the biology python import nemo_pcn as nemo biology nemo parameters e 398 5188 s 0 25 alpha 0 1438 mu 0 10 h 0 17 m 0 35 b 0 45 regulation establishment here e denotes eggs per female s the establishment probability m the male probability on a susceptible cultivar mu yearly natural egg mortality h spontaneous hatching without host and b an additional yearly biocontrol loss probability the default parameterisation is a working example not a universal field estimate step 2 choose a management programme s denotes susceptible potato r denotes masculinizing resistant potato n denotes a nonhost year rnn produces a resistant crop every three calendar years python calendar nemo schedule rnn years 30 print calendar table biology b head step 3 simulate python result nemo run_simulation biology calendar initial_density 20 virulence_frequency 20 area_m2 05 n_replicates 1000 seed 21 step 4 inspect annual density and allele frequencies python print result summary density print result summary allele print result summary homozygote frequencies are undefined after extinction and stored as missing values density is zero after extinction shaded trajectory intervals are prediction intervals across independent replicate populations not uncertainty intervals around their mean step 5 evaluate agricultural endpoints python print result outcomes 5 10 20 30 the table distinguishes the probability of ending below the chosen density threshold of remaining below it for the specified verification window and of reaching the absorbing extinction state step 6 save an analysis python from nemo_pcn viz import plot_trajectories save_figure result export outputs demo raw false fig plot_trajectories result save_figure fig outputs demo density pdf

title: Biological model
body: biological model state and genetic structure the population is characterised by three genotype counts n_ aa n_ aa and n_ aa a diallelic locus governs virulence towards a masculinizing resistance the virulence allele a is recessive only aa is virulent the allele frequency and virulent homozygote frequency are different quantities q n_ aa 2n_ aa 2n qquad v n_ aa n the default starting proportions use hardy weinberg 1 q 2 2q 1 q q 2 but users can give any nonnegative genotype composition hardy weinberg is an initial assumption not an equilibrium identity under the resistance recruitment and sex determination under establishment regulation each entering juvenile establishes independently with probability s 1 alpha n on susceptible potato an established individual becomes male with probability m irrespective of genotype on masculinizing resistant potato aa and aa become male with probability 1 while aa retains the probability m under the alternative fecundity regulated model establishment probability remains s and eggs per female decrease as e 1 alpha f kappa the two assumptions affect the demographic mechanism and must not be substituted without calibration genetic combinations let w_0 w_1 w_2 denote the genotype proportions among males the probabilities for each offspring genotype in the order aa aa aa are p_ aa text mother w_0 w_1 2 quad w_2 w_1 2 quad 0 p_ aa text mother w_0 2 w_1 4 quad w_0 w_1 w_2 2 quad w_2 2 w_1 4 p_ aa text mother 0 quad w_0 w_1 2 quad w_2 w_1 2 each female contributes according to its own genotype vector the offspring probabilities are weighted by the numbers of mothers in the three genotype classes these are direct genetic combinations without a hardy weinberg assumption at later generations eggs and survival a mother generates a poisson number of eggs with mean e or the regulated fecundity e_eff offspring genotypes are drawn independently from the corresponding combination probabilities each year eggs survive with probability 1 mu 1 h 1 b_t in a nonhost year no new generation is produced only egg survival occurs scale and mating the number of simulated individuals equals soil density times the mass of the assumed infested focus the default conversion uses a soil layer of 0 20 m and density of 1 4 g cm³ mating is random within the selected focus a large mapped infested area need not constitute one biological mating neighbourhood users should treat this scale as a structural assumption selected genetic equilibrium for 0 m 1 2 under continuous resistant cultivation the internal deterministic equilibrium frequency of aa is v 1 2 1 m the corresponding allele frequency is q 1 v 2 not sqrt v see the article and supplementary material for exact equilibrium conditions and extinction results

title: Stochastic simulation
body: stochastic and deterministic simulation core api python nemo run_simulation parameters schedule initial_density 20 virulence_frequency 2 genotype_initial none area_m2 1 n_replicates 1000 threshold 1 seed 42 each replicate uses a separately seeded random stream numba parallelises independent replicates while preserving the serial order of annual transitions within a replicate the simulation result contains density allele homozygote effective_size females males schedule parameters initial_density area_m2 threshold and seed arrays use replicate year dimensions breeder related arrays have one value per crop year transition density and frequencies include year 0 deterministic mean field reference python reference nemo deterministic parameters schedule initial_density 20 virulence_frequency 2 at large population size stochastic density trajectories concentrate around the mean field recursion under regularity assumptions this does not imply that the deterministic curve is exactly the expected stochastic density in a finite population large versus small reproductive populations when the expected number of reproductive aa females is large the 95 band can be visually much narrower than the plotted ordinate range for rare virulence and a small mating focus female recruitment can fail in the first resistant crop producing extinction even when a deterministic trajectory remains positive extracting and plotting distributions python r nemo run_simulation area_m2 0054 n_replicates 2000 seed 9 print r summary density year p025 median p975 from nemo_pcn viz import plot_trajectories fig plot_trajectories r density show_replicates 20 use result raw density for replicate level data and result export raw true to save exact underlying trajectories very large arrays may consume substantial memory reproducibility and computational limits record the model variant genotype initialization input units calendar soil scale and seed the integer valued algorithm can become costly for very large population sizes a probability close to one in a finite ensemble is not a mathematical certainty

title: Management programmes
body: rotations and suicide hatching biocontrol repeating crop sequences a schedule is a sequence of calendar years for example rn means one resistant potato year followed by one nonhost year rnn means one resistant year in three rsn introduces a susceptible potato year between resistant cultivation and the nonhost period the number of potato crops is an explicit consequence of the schedule rather than an implicitly assumed rotation index python for cycle in r rn rnn rnnn rnnnn rsn srn print cycle nemo schedule cycle years 12 crops annual biocontrol efficacy b represents additional loss in the current year due to a treatment such as suicide hatching it is distinct from the physical proportion of eggs that hatch and distinct from an efficacy observed after one field application high values should be interpreted as scenarios unless independently validated for the proposed repeated programme python constant nemo schedule rnn years 30 biocontrol 45 annual nemo schedule rnn years 6 biocontrol 20 70 85 20 60 75 treatment timing python s1 nemo treatment_timing rnnnn 50 8 every_year s2 nemo treatment_timing rnnnn 50 8 nonhost_years s3 nemo treatment_timing rnnnn 50 8 once_per_cycle s4 nemo treatment_timing rnnnn 50 8 first_year_only comparing strategies python results nemo compare_strategies cycles rn rnn rnnn rnnnn rsn srn biocontrol 0 2 4 6 8 9 virulence 05 2 6 years 50 horizons 5 10 20 30 40 50 n_replicates 1000 area_m2 05 the returned table reports estimated probability of being below threshold sustained suppression eradication number of potato crops and mean density it permits transparent comparison of rapidity and agricultural exposure it does not estimate economic costs without additional data management endpoints below threshold density at a specific horizon is below the chosen agronomic threshold ever below threshold the threshold was crossed at least once before the horizon sustained suppression a full window of consecutive years was observed under the threshold eradication the integer population reached the absorbing state zero in the closed system official quarantine release and post treatment sampling require procedures outside this model

title: Genetic drift
body: virulence drift and reproductive bottlenecks selected and neutral frequencies the virulence allele is selected on resistant hosts because only aa juveniles can recruit reproductive females a neutral genetic marker in contrast has no direct effect on its carrier s sex or establishment probability the neutral marker module assumes free recombination between loci python result nemo simulate_neutral_marker parameters nemo parameters b 0 schedule nemo schedule r years 20 initial_density 20 virulence_frequency 2 marker_frequency 4 area_m2 0054 n_replicates 2000 seed 42 print result summary frequencies are reported among surviving populations the survival fraction is always retained because excluding extinct replicates changes the conditioning of any frequency estimate sex ratio effective size proxy the quantity n_e sex 4mf m f summarises the effect of unequal reproductive sex numbers it is not a generally exact genetic effective population size variance of family size consanguinity selection and spatial mating structure may further alter true drift rates initial reproductive failure the following expression is exact under the stated independent initial genotype assignment and establishment assumptions python risk nemo female_recruitment_risk q0 01 area_m2 0054 initial_density 80 print risk the expected number of virulent females depends on both absolute population size and q_0 2 a small focal population can fail to recruit any females on the first resistant crop even if the corresponding deterministic fraction remains positive contrasting sources of variability python experiments nemo compare_stochasticity_mechanisms schedule nemo schedule r years 20 area_m2 0054 virulence_frequency 2 n_replicates 2000 summary nemo summarize_stochasticity_comparison experiments the partial stochasticity models are explicit counterfactual numerical diagnostics their results depend on intervention definitions and integer rounding they should not be described as a unique or exact causal decomposition of multi generation variability for the conditional allele copy variance selected_allele_variance_components reports the algebraic separation between offspring number randomness and genetic combination randomness given the breeders fixation and evolutionary rescue python print nemo fixation_window nemo parameters r 4 fixation is not synonymous with evolutionary rescue demonstrating sustained rescue requires distinguishing fixation preceding extinction from fixation followed by long term persistence especially when the population has very few breeders

title: Calibration
body: estimating demographic and genetic parameters calibration must begin with the observation process pot level egg counts published means and standard errors hatch counts residual eggs in cysts time series and population genetic samples cannot share one universal likelihood summary of available fitters function primary observation schema objective main limitation fit_recruitment_fecundity pi_eggs_per_g cysts_per_g cysts_se eggs_per_cyst eggs_per_cyst_se separate weighted recruitment and fecundity fits summary statistics are not raw pot counts fit_fecundity pi_eggs_per_g eggs_per_cyst eggs_per_cyst_se weighted constant or reciprocal fecundity does not identify establishment fit_hatching hatched tested and optional exposure binomial constant or exposure dependent hatching does not identify survival in soil fit_egg_survival alive tested years binomial cumulative annual survival cannot separate natural mortality and hatching fit_population_trajectory year density and optional se weighted deterministic trajectory depends on initial condition and fixed parameters fit_allele_trajectory year a_copies allele_copies binomial genetic observation fit does not include process noise likelihood fit_reproduction_factor pi_eggs_per_g pf_eggs_per_g and optional pf_se weighted one crop pi pf response identifiability depends on fixed biological assumptions greenhouse calibration compatible with the manuscript the package includes the published summary data from contina dandurand and knudsen 2019 plant disease doi 10 1094 pdis 04 19 0717 re the trial 1 and pooled trials 2 3 are preserved separately the observations concern initial eggs per g soil cysts per g soil and eggs per cyst python import pandas as pd import nemo_pcn as nemo obs pd read_csv nemo pcn data published_greenhouse_summary csv group obs obs trial trials_2_3 fit nemo fit_recruitment_fecundity group hatch_viability 45 m 35 fecundity constant bootstrap 500 seed 12 print fit estimates print fit diagnostics fit export outputs greenhouse_fit the recruitment equation is c p_i frac 0 45 p_i s 1 m 1 alpha 0 45 p_i the constant eggs per cyst observation model is e p_i e and the alternative reciprocal model is e p_i e_0 1 theta p_i recruitment parameters cannot generally be uniquely recovered from final eggs per g alone parameters that are held fixed must be recorded fitting hatching assays python h pd dataframe hatched 18 37 54 tested 100 100 100 exposure 2 5 10 fit nemo fit_hatching h model exponential print fit estimates this illustrates a binomial likelihood not a claim that exposure time is the sole determinant of experimental hatch response fitting genetic samples python genetic pd dataframe year 0 1 2 3 a_copies 40 58 85 105 allele_copies 200 200 200 200 fit nemo fit_allele_trajectory genetic cycle r fit m this is a conditional sampling likelihood against deterministic trajectories at low population sizes state space particle methods would be needed to jointly infer selection and process drift identifiability and validation a successful optimiser is not evidence that every biological parameter is identified inspect residuals profile surfaces alternative mortality decompositions and fitted predictions on omitted experimental levels transferability to a different population requires data collected under the target soil cultivar and management context

title: Sensitivity and robustness
body: parameter sensitivity and robust decisions global sensitivity nemo_pcn sensitivity_screen implements a saltelli jansen design over independent continuous parameter ranges it estimates first order and total order sensitivity indices for final density and extinction probability python sens nemo sensitivity_screen bounds e 300 500 s 15 35 alpha 08 30 b 20 90 q0 05 80 cycles rnn years 35 n_base 128 n_replicates 500 seed 42 the expected response at each parameter vector is estimated by monte carlo the final indices are therefore affected by stochastic response noise evaluate convergence in both the sobol base size and the replications per design small negative or greater than one finite sample estimates should not be silently truncated or treated as proven effects robustness across parameterisations python models establishment nemo establishment_reference fecundity nemo original_fecundity compare nemo calibration_robustness models cycle rnnnn horizon 50 q0 20 replications 1000 comparing two structural models fitted to different data contexts is an examination of model uncertainty it is not a fair predictive contest unless each is refitted to comparable observations and evaluated on independent data local population subdivision python patches nemo compare_isolated_patches area_m2 05 patch_counts 1 2 4 8 schedule nemo schedule rnn 50 n_replicates 500 each patch is closed and internally panmictic this diagnostic does not model dispersal migration or the actual geography of a potato field a connected spatial model would require explicit movement parameters and spatial validation decision horizons it is generally useful to evaluate 5 10 20 30 and 50 years on the same simulation ensemble longer extinction tails may be relevant to mathematical extinction theory but need not dominate agricultural decision making report crop exposure initial infestation virulence and parameter uncertainty alongside predicted probabilities

title: Modelling scope
body: assumptions diagnostics and responsible interpretation demographic assumptions the current model has one generation per potato crop does not resolve within year root ecology treats all eggs as hatching on host encounter and uses constant demographic parameters unless the calendar specific biocontrol rate is supplied field data may support more detailed stage dependent mortality and recruitment than can be identified from egg densities alone genetic assumptions the selected locus is diallelic and virulence recessive sex dependent selection on masculinizing resistance is represented mutation multiple resistance loci migration explicit relatedness and linkage are not part of the standard three genotype engine neutral marker analysis represents one unlinked locus and cannot by itself recover the full effective population size or the mating neighbourhood in a field spatial assumptions area controls the number of simulated nematodes not a spatial movement process panmixia across a whole mapped infestation may overestimate the effective number of breeders the isolated patch diagnostic is a sensitivity exercise not a diffusion model calibration limits different experimental designs can identify different demographic components mean cyst recruitment and mean eggs per cyst should not be reduced to a single pf statistic if both are observed fits to summary means are conditional on the reported standard errors and need independent evaluation observations from a different population or soil should not be pooled automatically quarantine and agronomy globodera pallida is a regulated quarantine pest output probabilities should assist scenario prioritisation sampling design and protocol assessment not replace official surveillance or statutory restrictions returning below one egg per gram in simulation is not evidence that all cysts have disappeared from the field technical scope the python stochastic kernel is accelerated by numba it supports integer populations that fit in signed 64 bit counts very large area and large initial densities may exceed useful computational resources for extremely large populations a deterministic approximation may be appropriate with local stochastic modelling where extinction or rare genotype events matter

title: Development
body: development and validation repository structure text nemo pcn pyproject toml src nemo_pcn model py engine py genetics py experiments py analysis py calibration py viz py data published_greenhouse_summary csv examples tests docs running tests bash python m pip install e nemo pcn dev viz python m pytest nemo pcn tests q the tests verify genotype combination probabilities calendars reproducible independent random draws extinction as an absorbing state agreement with a deterministic large population benchmark and parameter fitting interfaces a passing software test does not establish biological validity outside the calibration context scientific checks before publication 1 reproduce published formulae and use dimensions consistently 2 compare stochastic medians with deterministic trajectories in the large population regime 3 quantify prediction intervals in small reproductive populations and evaluate extinction events 4 retain extinct replicates when estimating survival probabilities but exclude undefined allele frequencies from frequency summaries 5 check fitted residuals parameter identifiability and alternative regulation hypotheses 6 run sensitivity convergence diagnostics and independent parameter seed checks 7 validate management predictions on independent experimental or field measurements when available versioning and publication release tags should record changes in model equations fit assumptions random generator behaviour and export schema an apparent parameter improvement from one experimental data set should not silently replace a reference parameter set in an existing reproducible study
